response.sql: WITH rep AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), r2 AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, cnt, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_avg, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total FROM rep) SELECT City, SUM(cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(cnt - city_avg) AS avg_above_city_avg, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / total) AS avg_share FROM r2 WHERE cnt > city_avg GROUP BY City
